title: runstate v0.2 launcher convention
description: Pins the bodies of the launcher.* topics the spawner/reaper produces: launched (spawn-intent + liveness handle) and terminated (the manner of death; only a wait()ing parent can produce it). Applied on top of the envelope schema.

Launched.description: Spawn-intent plus the worker's liveness handle. status is 'running' for the reference launchers; the domain may widen (e.g. intended/failed) via a convention-version bump.

Terminated.description: The manner of death (present-nullable + reason-coupled): every key is present; the inapplicable one is null. 'exited' carries a non-null exit_code (signal null); 'killed' carries a non-null signal (exit_code null) -- the pairing is enforced, so illegal states (exited-with-a-signal) stay unrepresentable.
